claw.name: Warband
claw.text: On Order — you may move a [Mob] to the Domain with the most cards. Brawl that Domain.

claw.name: Raid
claw.text:
On Brawl (*your turn*) — discard a card from your Domain.
On Brawl (*not your turn*) — give a card from your Domain to the active player.

claw.name: Scavenge
claw.text:
On Brawl (*your turn*) — remove a card from your discard from the game.
On Brawl (*not your turn*) — the active player puts a card from your discard into their Domain.

claw.name: Blood Offering
claw.text: On Order — discard a card from your Domain. Rite every Domain.

claw.name: Poach
claw.text: On Order (*no other [Hunt] in play*) — Feast your Domain. Draw a card from the Claw deck.

claw.name: Worship of the Hunt
claw.text: On Rite — discard 5 Claw cards to the active player's discard.

claw.name: Worship of the Dusk
claw.text:
On Rite — every player discards a card from their Domain.
On Rite (*Worship of the Dawn in play*) — every player discards a card from their Domain.

claw.name: Worship of War
claw.text: On Rite — the active player Brawls a Domain of their choice.

claw.name: Incite
claw.text: On Dawn — move up to 3 [Mob] cards from your Domain to other Domains. Discard Incite.

claw.name: Chiefdom
claw.text: On Dawn — move up to 2 [Mob] cards from your Domain or a Domain with Kinship to any other Domain.

claw.name: Kinship
claw.text: On Harvest — Order Advice.

claw.name: Racketeering
claw.text: On Order — choose a player. They offer you a card. Put it in your Domain, or refuse and Brawl their Domain.

claw.name: Tyranny
claw.text: On Order — draw cards from the Claw deck equal to your [Discontent] count. Brawl your Domain.

claw.name: Marauders
claw.text: On Feast — Discard Marauders. Draw a card from the Claw deck.

claw.name: Share the Spoils
claw.text: On Feast — draw a card from the Claw deck.

claw.name: Martial Excellence
claw.text: On Order (*[Trophy] in your Domain*) — Order Challenge.

claw.name: Outriders
claw.text: On Order — draw 3 cards from the Claw deck, then discard one of them.

claw.name: Land Grab
claw.text: On Order (*[Land] in the Season*) — put all [Land] cards from the Season into your Domain. Discard Land Grab.

claw.name: Rite of Passage
claw.text: On Brawl — draw a card from the Tree deck.

claw.name: Culling
claw.text: On Dawn — the player with the most cards in their Domain discards 2 cards from their Domain. Discard Culling.

claw.name: Ivory
claw.text: On Order — Discard Ivory. Order Barter.

claw.name: Hunger
claw.text:
On Harvest — discard the top card of the Claw deck.
On Feast — return a card from your discard to top of the Claw deck.

claw.name: Uprising
claw.text: On Dawn — Brawl your Domain. Discard Uprising.

claw.name: Ransack
claw.text: On Order — discard a card from your Domain. Draw 2 cards from the Claw deck. Put a card from the Season into your Domain.

claw.name: Spoils of War
claw.text:
On Dawn — move Spoils of War to another player's Domain.
On Brawl — moves to the active player's Domain. They draw cards from the Claw and Tree decks equal to their [Trophy] count.

claw.name: Veil Tear
claw.text: On Order — remove any number of cards from your discard from the game. Return that many [Spiritual] cards from any discard to their owner's Domain. Rite every Domain that many times. Discard Veil Tear.

claw.name: Blood Feud
claw.text: On Brawl — draw 2 cards from the Claw deck. Move up to 2 [Mob] to the active player's Domain. Discard Blood Feud, then Brawl the active player's Domain.

claw.name: Enforcers
claw.text:
On Brawl (*your turn*) — draw 2 cards from the Claw deck.
On Brawl (*not your turn*) — you and the active player each draw 2 cards from the Claw deck.

sword.name: Royal Hunt
sword.text: On Order (*no other [Hunt] in play*) — Feast your Domain twice. Draw a card from the Claw deck.

sword.name: Gold Coat
sword.text: On Rumour, Brawl — the active player chooses a Domain and discards a [Unit] of their choice there. Gold Coat moves to that Domain.

sword.name: Iron Crown
sword.text: On Dawn — the active player chooses a Domain and discards a [Unit] of their choice there. Iron Crown moves to that Domain.

sword.name: Green Mantle
sword.text: On Harvest — the active player chooses a Domain and discards a [Unit] of their choice there. Green Mantle moves to that Domain.

sword.name: White Shield
sword.text: On Feast — the active player chooses a Domain and discards a [Unit] of their choice there. White Shield moves to that Domain.

sword.name: Holy Cross
sword.text: On Rite — the active player chooses a Domain and discards a [Unit] of their choice there. Holy Cross moves to that Domain.

tree.name: Eldership
tree.text: On Brawl (*active player has Kinship*) — cancel the Brawl in your Domain. They draw a card from the Tree deck.

tree.name: Worship of the Dawn
tree.text:
On Rite — return a card from your discard to your Domain.
On Rite (*Worship of the Dusk in play*) — return a card from your discard to your Domain.

tree.name: Reaping
tree.text: On Dawn — Harvest every Domain. Discard Reaping.

tree.name: Gathering
tree.text: On Dawn — choose Brawl, Rite, or Rumour. Triggers in your Domain and every Domain with Kinship. Discard Gathering.

tree.name: Sacred Grove
tree.text: On Order — reveal the top 3 cards from the Tree deck. Put any [Spiritual] cards from the revealed and the Season into your Domain. Discard the rest of the revealed. Rite your Domain.

tree.name: Worship of the Hearth
tree.text: On Rite — Harvest every Domain that has Kinship.

tree.name: Forage
tree.text: On Order — discard the top 2 cards from the Tree deck and the top 2 cards from the Claw deck. Feast your Domain.

tree.name: Sowing
tree.text:
On Order (*2+ [Nature] in your Domain*) — Order Expand.
On Harvest — refill the Season, then put all [Nature] cards from the Season into your Domain.

tree.name: Compost
tree.text:
On Order (*Reaping card in your discard*) — choose one:
• Order Expand.
• Remove the Reaping card from your discard from the game, then Harvest your Domain.

tree.name: Vigil
tree.text: On Harvest — for each player with Kinship, return a card from your discard to your Domain.

tree.name: Floods
tree.text:
On Brawl (*another Floods in play*) — cancel the Brawl in your Domain.
On Dawn — refill the Season.
On Dawn (*another Floods in play*) — every player discards a card from their Domain.

tree.name: Bog
tree.text: On Rumour — remove a card from the Season from the game.

tree.name: Bear's Den
tree.text: On Feast — draw a card from the Claw deck.

tree.name: Ravine
tree.text: On Brawl — the active player discards a card from their Domain.

tree.name: Meadow
tree.text: On Harvest — refill the Season to full.

tree.name: Regrowth
tree.text: On Dawn — all [Nature] cards in every player's discard return to their owner's Domain. Discard Regrowth.

tree.name: Hospitality
tree.text: On Order — choose a player with Kinship. You may Order a card in their Domain. They may Order a card in yours.

wheat.name: Animal Husbandry
wheat.text:
On Order — choose one:
• Order Expand.
• Order Barter.
• Feast your Domain.

wheat.name: Tavern
wheat.text: On Feast — you may return a [Discontent] from your Domain to top of the Claw deck. You may return a Claw card from your discard to top of the Claw deck.

wheat.name: Militia
wheat.text:
On Rumour — discard a [Mob] from your Domain.
On Brawl — Discard Militia to cancel the Brawl in your Domain.

wheat.name: Crooked Inn
wheat.text: On Rumour — return a [Mob] from your discard to your Domain.

wheat.name: Enclosure
wheat.text: On Order — put any card from the Village into your Domain. Put a card from your Domain back in its place.

wheat.name: Ritual Pyre
wheat.text: On Order — discard a card from your Domain. If you do, Harvest your Domain. Rite your Domain.

wheat.name: Folk Hero
wheat.text: On Dawn — move a [Mob], [Labour], or [Amenity] card between Domains that have Wheat cards.

wheat.name: Wolf Pack
wheat.text:
On Harvest (*your turn*) — move Wolf Pack to another player's Domain.
On Harvest (*not your turn*) — discard 2 cards from your Domain, draw 2 cards from the Claw deck.

wheat.name: Herb Garden
wheat.text: On Harvest — Order Advice or Expand.

wheat.name: Orchard
wheat.text: On Harvest — draw a card from the Tree deck. Feast your Domain.

wheat.name: Reeve
wheat.text: On Dawn — Order a Wheat card in your Domain.

wheat.name: Worship of the Bread
wheat.text: On Rite — rearrange the Village belt.

wheat.name: Ora et Labora
wheat.text:
On Harvest — Order Worship.
On Rite — Order Expand.

wheat.name: Tax Collectors
wheat.text: On Order (*3+ [Labour]*) — Order Barter. Rumour your Domain.

wheat.name: Tidings
wheat.text:
On Rumour — choose one:
• *Panic* — draw 2 cards from the Claw deck.
• *Fortify* — return a [Discontent] to top of the Claw deck.

Discard Tidings.

wheat.name: Pilgrimage
wheat.text:
On Order — choose a player. Move any number of cards from your Domain to theirs. They choose this card's effect:
• *Pray* — Order Worship once per card moved.
• *Fight* — Brawl their Domain.

Discard Pilgrimage.

coin.name: Market
coin.text: On Order — choose a player and a card from the Wares. They may put it into their Domain. If they do, Order Barter.

coin.name: Pawn Shop
coin.text:
On Order — Order Barter.
On Rumour — swap a card from your Domain with a card from the Wares.

coin.name: Stockpile
coin.text: On Order — put a card from your Domain into the Wares. Order Barter.

coin.name: Smuggler
coin.text: On Brawl — choose a card from the Wares. Put it into the active player's Domain. Smuggler moves to the active player's Domain.

coin.name: Forgery
coin.text: On Order (*Coin card in your Domain*) — put Forgery into Wares. Order Barter.

coin.name: Usurer
coin.text:
On Order — put a card from your Domain into the Wares.
On Rumour — Order Barter.

coin.name: Highwaymen
coin.text: On Brawl — put a card from your Domain into the Wares. The active player Orders Barter.

coin.name: Sellsword
coin.text: On Brawl — move Sellsword to the Wares to cancel the Brawl in your Domain.

coin.name: Swindle
coin.text: On Order — move all Wares to a chosen opponent's Domain. Brawl their Domain. Discard Swindle.

coin.name: Prosperity
coin.text: On Dawn — draw a card from the Coin deck.

coin.name: Embassy
coin.text: On Dawn (*Kinship*) — you and each player with Kinship put a card from the Wares into your Domains.

coin.name: Efficiency
coin.text: On Order — Order up to 4 other cards in your Domain. Discard Efficiency.

coin.name: Spice Market
coin.text: On Order — draw cards from the Coin deck equal to your count of unique tags in your Domain.

coin.name: Commodities
coin.text: On Rumour — draw a card from a chosen deck. Put it into the Wares.

coin.name: Provisions
coin.text: On Feast — draw a card from the Coin deck.

coin.name: Worship of Gold
coin.text: On Rite — the active player puts a card from the Wares into their Domain.

candle.name: Worship of the Scripture
candle.text: On Rite — the active player looks at cards from the Candle deck equal to their [Spiritual] count. They keep one, remove the rest from the game.

candle.name: Worship of the Relic
candle.text: On Rite — the active player looks at cards from a chosen deck equal to their [Spiritual] count. They may remove the top card of the Candle deck from the game and put one of the looked-at cards in its place. Return the rest to top of the deck.

candle.name: Worship of the Martyr
candle.text: On Rite — the active player may discard cards from their Domain equal to their [Spiritual] count. If they do, every other player must do the same.

candle.name: Clergy
candle.text: On Order — look at cards from the Candle deck equal to the number of players with [Religion]. Put one into your Domain, put one on top of the Candle deck, remove the rest from the game.

candle.name: Zealot
candle.text:
On Brawl (*[Religion]*) — cancel the Brawl in your Domain.
On Brawl (*no [Religion]*) — discard a card from your Domain.
On Rite — the active player may move Zealot to another Domain.

candle.name: Evangelism
candle.text: On Order — each player Orders Worship.
candle.reminder: In turn order, starting with you.

candle.name: Purity
candle.text: On Order — you may remove a card from the top of the Candle deck from the game. Rite your Domain.

candle.name: Penance
candle.text: On Dawn — discard 2 cards from your Domain. You may discard Penance.

candle.name: Ornament
candle.text: On Order — move the top card of the Candle deck to the Wares.
